prompts.name: queen
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent chess-game character sprite pair.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: queen cat chess figurine. Extract this exact figurine and its necessary base/accessories from the photo, then duplicate it once. This is a faithful background extraction plus recolor, not a redesign.
Output a wide canvas of two equal half frames. Center the original ivory-and-gold character in the LEFT half; center an identical geometry charcoal-and-antique-gold version in the RIGHT half. Both full figures must have exactly the same scale, angle, pose, silhouette, accessories and baseline. Leave clear transparent margins around each and clear separation along the centerline for clean splitting into two assets.
Preserve the open gold royal crown, scepter held on viewer left, small gold key held on viewer right, upright pose and simple cylindrical ivory pedestal.
Keep the round cat head, cat ears, short limbs, round eye and X eye, characteristic facial marks, materials and sculpted details. The right version changes ivory material to deep charcoal ceramic and gold to antique gold only; eye details remain readable.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere around both isolated figures. No floor plane, background, fake checkerboard, cast ground shadow, text, labels, typography, sparkles or watermarks. Remove all labels and watermarks present in input. Full character and full necessary base uncropped, no additional objects.
